'File Name: packages/intents-sdk/src/intents/interfaces/intent-signer.ts -> Scope: High. THE FEE THE USER PAYS MUST EQUAL THE FEE THE SDK DISPLAYED. `getFeeQuote` falls back to an exact-in quote sized from `tokens()` USD prices times 1.2 and accepts up to a 1.5x `amount_out / feeAmount` ratio; `HotBridge.estimateWithdrawalFee` multiplies `gasPrice` by 100 on Plasma; `OmniBridge.estimateWithdrawalFee` folds `storageDepositFee` into the quote while `deriveOmniWithdrawIntentParams` also emits a `storage_deposit` of `nativeFee` for `prefundedNativeFeeTokens` whose `amount` was reported as 0; `FEE_SUBSIDIZED_TOKENS` zero `native_token_fee` after the API returned one; `DirectBridge` and `AuroraEngineBridge` quote `minStorageBalance - userStorageBalance` from cached values; `getQuote.matchesRequest` filters solver quotes. Show a user paying more than `feeEstimation.amount`, or a solver or relayer being handed more than the real cost: a `token_diff` selling `amount_in` for an `amount_out` nobody needs; a fee quoted against the wrong `feeAssetId` on HOT; a storage deposit charged twice; a solver quote that passes `matchesRequest` yet moves a different token amount; a stale cache turning a zero fee into a positive one. Identity: value leaving the user's balance beyond `withdrawalParams.amount` == `feeEstimation.amount`, and nothing above the relayer's real cost is transferred to any party.'
